say:3:1013408002:2.text: Is that really how you feel? I've seen you getting attention wherever you go. I almost thought you were the type who's always "all smiles". But well...
say:3:1013408002:2.source_cn: 你真的这么想？看到你无论在哪里都是前呼后拥，我还以为你...

say:4:1013408003:1.text: You asked me to be your guide, and yet you were still double-checking the map...
say:4:1013408003:1.source_cn: 我刚才都看到了。你明明拜托了我带路，却还不放心地掏出地...

say:5:1013408004:1.text: It's really disheartening. You don't even trust me this much? Even after I lent you a hand in the Dark Forest.
say:5:1013408004:1.source_cn: 真让人伤心。就这么不信任我？我好歹也在薄暮丛林帮过你们。

say:7:1013408006:1.text: ...Please trust me. No matter what doubts you have or what you've heard, it's better not to hastily conclude that I'm unforgivable...
